themes.name: UX, Search & Recommendations
themes.blurb: Poor app navigation, clunky search, missing category browsing, and irrelevant recommendations directly block users from discovering and exploring new categories.
themes.questionItAnswers: How does the UI/UX enable or block category discovery?

themes.name: Trust & Risk Deficit
themes.blurb: Users fear trying new categories due to quality concerns, damaged/expired items, unfamiliar brands, and difficult return/refund processes.
themes.questionItAnswers: What stops users from taking the first step into a new category?

topQuotes.text: Incorrect order being delivered in the packaging. Pathetic customer service. No customer redressal mechanism. No quality checks shared. In short once you place an order you don't have any other option but to just accept this whatever is delivered to you. absolutely pathetic.

The quality of products varies a lot depending on which dark store serves your area. When I order from my home, the products are great. But at my office location, the same products come in poor condition. Very inconsistent.

Ordered a USB cable and earphones from Blinkit. The quality was okay for the price. Wouldn't buy expensive electronics here but for accessories and small items it's convenient. The return policy for electronics is unclear though.

themes.name: Price Perception Barrier
themes.blurb: Users perceive non-grocery categories as overpriced compared to Amazon, Flipkart, local stores, or competitors like Zepto/BigBasket. Lack of first-time deals discourages trial.
themes.questionItAnswers: Is pricing a primary hurdle for cross-category exploration?

themes.name: Information Scarcity
themes.blurb: Users lack the information needed to make purchase decisions in unfamiliar categories — insufficient product details, missing reviews, no brand guidance.
themes.questionItAnswers: What information is missing before users commit to a new category?

themes.name: Discovery Difficulty
themes.blurb: Users are unaware Blinkit offers categories beyond groceries. Discovery is accidental, search is poor, and recommendations are absent or irrelevant.
themes.questionItAnswers: Why can't users find new categories?

themes.questionItAnswers: What psychological barriers prevent exploration even when users are aware of new categories?
